name: Glebe Stores

layers.essential_history: [[c:This is the village shop, and it used to be the post office.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:There's more history for this stop to come.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: in the 1600s, news travelled by messenger. ]]Alice[[c:'s way home from the dispatch room was a good deal longer than it should have been.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head south-east for about 100 metres to the village history board. Look for the board near the shop and the church. Keep to the pavements and paths, and look from the road only.]]
support: [[c:Support the village: Glebe Stores is the village shop. Pop in for a snack or a treat for later, because spending here helps keep it going.]]

character_art.caption: [[c:Alice the messenger, with a sealed letter. Glebe Stores used to be the village post office, so it felt like the right place to meet her.]]
